name: Filtered Webinar List
description: Published webinars, split into upcoming and archived, with a row of dropdown filters. Each page defines its own filter vocabulary in audience-familiar words; a webinar is tagged once and every page decides which axes it exposes. Unlike the other components, this one stays live: it reflects the webinars as they are on each visit rather than as they were when it was placed.
source:
{$ param groups label="Filter Groups" type="textarea" default="Audience: Professional Development, For the Public | Topic: Citizen Science Month, Animals, Pollinators, Space, Citizen Science Kits, Human Health | Age: All Ages or Families, Youth, Teens, Adults" description="One dropdown per group, separated by |. Each group is a label, a colon, then its options separated by commas. The options must match the tags on the webinars themselves. Avoid quote marks." $}
{$^ widget webinar_list groups="*groups" $}
